messages.content: 計算一筆本金為$10000，年利率為5%，期限為3年的複利。

function.name: calculate_mortgage_payment

message.content:
以下是按 **年複利**（每年一次複利）計算的結果：

| 項目 | 計算式 | 結果 |
|------|--------|------|
| 本金 (P) | 10,000 美元 | 10,000 |
| 年利率 (r) | 5% → 0.05 | 0.05 |
| 期數 (n) | 3 年 | 3 |
| 未來價值 (FV) | \(P(1+r)^n\) | \(10{,}000 \times (1+0.05)^3 = 10{,}000 \times 1.157625 = 11{,}576.25\) |
| 總利息 | FV – P | 11,576.25 – 10,000 = **1,576.25** |

> **結論**：在每年複利的情況下，三年後本金將增至 11,576.25 美元，總共賺取 1,576.25 美元的利息。

如果你想要更細節的分解（例如每年的累積利息），或是使用不同的複利頻率（如半年、季度、月度等），請告訴我，我可以再幫你做進一步的計算！
message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate compound interest? They say "複利" which means compound interest. They want to calculate a compound interest on principal $10,000, annual interest rate 5%, term 3 years. They didn't specify compounding frequency. Usually it's annual compounding unless otherwise specified. So we can compute future value: FV = P*(1 + r)^n where r=0.05, n=3. So FV = 10000*(1+0.05)^3 = 10000*1.157625 = 11576.25. So interest earned = 11576.25 - 10000 = 1576.25.

We can provide that. Also maybe they want monthly mortgage payment? But they said "複利" not mortgage. So just compound interest. Provide calculation.
